disciplines.title: Disciplines
disciplines.weaponNoRatingHint: This weapon carries no HEMA Ratings figures.
disciplines.name: Name
disciplines.slugHint: Names the discipline in exports and spreadsheets; fencers never see it.
disciplines.whenHint: A rough time, for example "Saturday morning".
disciplines.whereHint: A place within the venue, for example "Main Hall".
disciplines.rulesetHint: The ruleset's name, and a link to its text when one is published — several links when the rules exist in more than one language.
disciplines.rowInvalid: Enter a weapon, capacity, and (for a team discipline) roster bounds for this row; a weapon outside the taxonomy also needs a name.
disciplines.compositionDeadlineHint: The date by which team rosters are expected to be complete. Locks nothing — it only flags short rosters for the organizer after this date.

disciplineDialog.duplicateName: Another discipline in this tournament already uses this name.

extras.title: Extra services
extras.name: Name
extras.optionLabelHint: Name of one thing the fencer picks when selecting this item, for example "size". Leave empty for no option.
extras.optionChoicesHint: Comma-separated allowed answers, for example "S, M, L, XL". Leave empty for free text.
extras.rowInvalid: Enter a name and price for this row.

team.title: Organizing team
team.hint: Everyone listed here gets full console access to this tournament, the same as the owner. Only someone already on this list can become the new owner.
team.addPlaceholder: Add a team member by e-mail
team.transferHint: Transfer ownership to a team member
team.unknownEmail: No account with that e-mail exists.
team.alreadyMember: That account is already on the team.
team.addFailed: Could not add the team member.
team.transferNotMember: Only an existing team member can become the owner.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.deleteHint: No registrations yet — this tournament can be permanently deleted.
danger.cancelHint: This tournament has registrations, so it cannot be deleted. You can cancel it instead: it disappears from public listings, stops accepting registrations, and all data (including financial history) is retained.
danger.alreadyCancelled: This tournament is cancelled. Its data is retained and the console stays accessible.
danger.failed: The action failed. Please try again.

bankAccount.title: Bank account
bankAccount.label: Account
bankAccount.hint: Enter either an IBAN, for example "CZ6508000000192000145399", or the Czech domestic form, for example "19-2000145399/0800". Registrations cannot be paid until an account is recorded here — required as soon as the tournament charges anything.

currency.title: Currency
currency.rateHint: How many units of the local currency one euro is worth — for example 25.5 CZK per EUR. Used only for the "Recalculate missing" button.
currency.rateWarning: That rate looks implausible. Check the direction: local-currency units per 1 EUR.
currency.rateNote: The rate is only a convenience for filling in missing prices — stored prices, totals, and payment instructions never change when it changes.
currency.legacyFixedFeesBlockEur: This tournament uses the legacy fixed weapon-rental/afterparty fees, which have no EUR counterpart — switch to itemized extra services to enable EUR.

timeline.title: Dates
timeline.opensHint: Registration opens on this day. Before it the tournament is visible but nobody can enter. Unset, it opens as soon as the tournament is published. Set an opening time beside it and it opens at that hour instead of at the start of the day.
timeline.seatingHint: Not the registration close. After this day registration stays open but grants only a place in the queue, and any reservation that still owes money moves below the line. Unset, it falls on the registration close.
timeline.closesHint: The hard close: after this day no entry is accepted at all. Unset, it falls on the tournament date.
timeline.compositionHint: The day by which teams should have reached their discipline's minimum size. It only reminds — no roster is locked, no team is cancelled or moved to the queue, and no capacity is freed. Unset, there is no deadline and no reminders.
timeline.anchor: Tournament: {{date}} — set on the tournament tab.
timeline.timezoneHint: The tournament's local time. Every date and time on this timeline is read in it.

paymentMode.title: How fencers pay
paymentMode.effect.immediate: Full amount due within {{days}} days of registering. Unpaid, the seat is released.
paymentMode.effect.deposit: Deposit due within {{days}} days, the rest by {{deadline}}.
paymentMode.effect.reservation: Seat held free until {{deadline}}. Still unpaid then, the fencer moves to the queue.

legacyFees.title: Legacy fixed fees
legacyFees.explanation: This tournament still prices through the old fixed weapon-rental and afterparty fees. They have no EUR counterpart, so EUR cannot be enabled while they are set, and they are no longer editable — extra-service items replace them. Clearing them discards the amounts below.

exportSheet.title: Sheet export
exportSheet.hint: The Google Sheet the export writes into.

mode.title: Tournament mode
mode.easyHint: Only the essentials — the tournament, its disciplines, its dates and its prices. Recommended.
mode.advancedHint: Choose which advanced features the tournament uses.
mode.nothingChosen: With no feature chosen this is easy mode.

hint.schedule: For larger tournaments with several disciplines on different days and in different places. Disciplines then state where and when they occur.
hint.payments: For organizers who want Squire to handle payment processing.
hint.teams: For tournaments including one or more team disciplines.

mode.confirmIntro: Turning the feature off hides this:

hiding.schedule: disciplines carrying a time and place: {{count}}

mode.stillSold: Nothing is deleted. Hidden items are still sold and fencers still see them — only their settings go out of sight, and they come back unchanged when the feature is turned on again.
mode.paymentsConsequence: Squire stops asking for money: no payment instructions, QR codes, reminders or expiry of unpaid reservations. Prices, currency, discounts and credited payments all stay recorded.
mode.failed: The mode could not be saved.
